job.title: Senior HR Business Partner
job.description:
See out the end of the year and apply your HR skills to a role in a highly reputable nationally recognised organisation. 
  
  
Let's start with what's in it for you…
  • Work for a one of a kind, large Australian brand
  • Senior, hands-on role with a strong Employee Relations and Performance focus with some project work
  • Contract role until end of December with potential for the role to extend
  • Attractive hourly rate on offer
  • Full time - will consider applicants seeking 4 days or 9 day fortnight
  • 3/4 days in the office, 1 day from home
  • Docklands location - very close to public transport
  • Modern offices with onsite café
  • Work alongside a high performing, collaborative and experienced People & Culture team
  • ASAP start


The Company

With a values-led, ambitious and team-first culture, our client is currently looking for an experienced Senior People Business Partner to join their People & Culture team during a period of increased workload. The head office is based in Docklands and you will be joining a HR team that are dynamic and high performing. 


The Role

This is not your typical HRBP role supporting one dedicated client group.
You will work flexibly across the organisation, with a strong focus on Employee Relations and Performance matters, while also providing support across broader people initiatives and priority projects.

This is a great opportunity for someone who can hit the ground running, quickly build relationships across different areas of the organisation and provide trusted, practical HR advice in a busy environment.
  • Lead a varied portfolio of Employee Relations and Performance matters,
  • Provide confident, practical advice and support to leaders on complex people matters
  • Manage sensitive workplace matters with sound judgement
  • Lead and deliver priority People & Culture projects
  • Support organisational change activities
  • Assist with workforce, performance, engagement and other people processes as required
  • Maintain accurate case records, correspondence and supporting documentation
  • Work collaboratively with the wider People & Culture team to ensure matters are progressed and resolved efficiently
  • Identify recurring themes, risks and opportunities for improvement
  • Build effective working relationships quickly and adapt to different leaders, teams and operating environments
What will I need to succeed?
  • Proven experience in a Senior HR Business Partner/HR Manager/ER/IR specialist role within a fast paced and complex environment 
  • Strong knowledge of contemporary HR practices
  • A degree or Post Graduate Qualification in HR
  • Demonstrated knowledge with employee and industrial relations including Fair Work 
  • Ability to negotiate, influence and liaise to achieve desired outcomes
  • Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work under pressure
  • Resourceful and have practical common sense
If you’re an experienced HRBP who is hands-on, loves ER and can jump in and make an immediate impact, we would love to hear from you.

Please apply with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role.
Interviews will be held immediately.
Good luck!

job.title: Senior Financial Accountant
job.description:
This is an exciting opportunity for a CA-qualified accountant with a blend of Big 4 and industry experience to join a growing business during an exciting period of change, growth and transformation.
 
What's in it for you?
  • Work in modern offices for a startup agribusiness that looks after their people - be part of the journey!
  • Very attractive salary on offer depending on experience
  • Full time, permanent role
  • Work from home flexibility - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
  • Central CBD location, close to cafes & shops
  • Brand new varied financial accountant role with the ability to make it your own
  • Strong mentorship and career development opportunities
  • Very fun and social culture with great company perks such as plenty of free brekkies, snacks and lunches, networking events and social activities
  • ASAP start
The Company

An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Financial Accountant to join this dynamic and thriving agribusiness who are located in the heart of Melbourne CBD. Their office is close to restaurants, cafes and retail shops. With a focus on mentorship and valuing input, the company promotes a professional and enjoyable work culture.

The Role

Reporting to the CFO, this is a hands-on opportunity for an experienced Financial Accountant to play a key role within a collaborative finance team. You will take ownership of financial reporting, month-end processes and maintaining strong financial controls, while partnering closely with both finance and operational stakeholders to provide accurate insights that support strategic business decisions. This is a varied role suited to someone who enjoys working in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where they can make a genuine impact.
Your responsibilities will include but not limited to:
  • Own the end-to-end month-end and year-end financial close process
  • Prepare monthly management accounts, financial reports and statutory financial statements in accordance with Australian Accounting Standards
  • Deliver accurate financial reporting and commercial insights to the CFO and senior leadership team
  • Maintain balance sheet integrity through reconciliations, strong financial controls and financial data governance
  • Manage fixed asset accounting, depreciation schedules, capital expenditure and inventory accounting
  • Coordinate the annual external audit, acting as the key liaison with auditors
  • Ensure compliance with BAS, GST, FBT, income tax and all relevant statutory requirements
  • Drive continuous improvement across finance systems, reporting processes and ERP enhancements
  • Partner with stakeholders to support budgeting, forecasting and business performance
  • Mentor and provide technical guidance to the finance team while fostering a collaborative, high-performing culture

What do I need to be successful?
  • CA or CPA qualified, supported by a tertiary qualification in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline
  • Proven accounting experience within a Big 4, and/or large, complex commercial business
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge including financial statements, month-end and statutory reporting, tax compliance including BAS, GST and FBT
  • Exposure to ERP systems (Xero is desirable) with advanced Excel skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  • A proactive, solutions-focused communicator who enjoys building strong stakeholder relationships and contributing to a collaborative team culture
